subject: Your instructor record has been updated
body:
Dear $instructor_name,

Your instructor record was updated on $updated_at by $updated_by.

What changed:
$changes

These details are used when courses are assigned and timetables are planned.

If any of this looks wrong, please contact your Head of Department or academic.admin@$email_domain.

Best regards,
Academic Administration Team

variables.changes: One line per changed field, showing the old and new value
